name: robots/qiangwang-academic__ur5e_robot_gym_env_real_and_sim
title: CoppeliaSim UR5 reaching environment v3 (legacy Gym)
intro: CoppeliaSim UR5 reaching environment v3 (legacy Gym), adapted from qiangwang-academic/ur5e_robot_gym_env_real_and_sim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
